known_gaps.summary: request_id carriage: stub run_job takes kind/hypothesis (repair-loop bookkeeping), not the admission request_id; engine run_job takes request_id only on GREEN-the-tests. Fuel adopts request_id per docs/fuel-contract.md; until then the check cannot pin submit-phase calls.

Job queries unwired engine-side: get_job_status, get_check_results, get_logs, list_job_kinds have no engine handler on GREEN-the-tests (merge/fuel-mcp wires the agent path including run_job-by-run_id; integration pending). Mappings pin shared envelope shapes only, never same-name engine wiring.

ack/completion run_id duality: on GREEN-the-tests the submit ack run_id (queue id) differs from the run_job completion run_id (execution id); join across phases by request_id. merge/fuel-mcp decides the ack run_id IS the execution id and run_job accepts run_id; the stub MUST NOT assume identity until this contract says so.
Error shapes unconverged: stub {error, message} vs engine MCP {ok: false, code, message}. Join and audit work MUST match on ids, not error bodies.

Constraints ownership: caller-supplied run_spice min/max are accepted on GREEN-the-tests HEAD; merge/fuel-mcp refuses caller targets in favor of project constraints. The stub MUST NOT treat caller targets as engine-accepted.

mappings.note: run_id addresses a run on both sides; the same-name engine query is unwired (GAP-2), so this pins the shared completion shape, not engine wiring.
Completion echo of the addressing id (GAP-2 applies: shared shape, not engine wiring).
Log reads address the execution id (GAP-2 applies: shared shape, not engine wiring).
Log page echo of the execution id (GAP-2 applies: shared shape, not engine wiring).
